init.title: Chandler Water System Options
init.description: Tune BLE polling cadence and automatic valve clock synchronization.

data_description.poll_interval: Seconds between short BLE polls when idle (default 60s). Each poll connects briefly and closes cleanly with the device reset command.
data_description.active_flow_poll_interval: Faster poll interval while water flow is > 0 GPM for near real-time usage tracking (0 to disable).
data_description.auto_sync_clock: Automatically set the valve's clock during a poll whenever drift exceeds the threshold (skipped while regenerating).
data_description.clock_sync_threshold: Minimum clock drift in seconds before automatically syncing the valve clock.

start_regeneration.name: Start regeneration
start_regeneration.description: Starts a regeneration cycle on the water system. A regeneration uses water and salt and cannot be cancelled once it begins.

when.name: When
when.description: Start the cycle immediately, or queue it for the next scheduled regeneration time.

find_home.name: Find home
find_home.description: Tells the valve to locate its home position. Useful after a 'Lost Home' or 'Can't Find Home' error.

set_salt_level.name: Set salt level
set_salt_level.description: Records how much salt is in the brine tank, for example after refilling it.

pounds.name: Salt
pounds.description: Pounds of salt currently in the brine tank.

reset_counters.name: Reset counters
reset_counters.description: Zeroes the resettable regeneration and gallon counters. Lifetime totals are not affected.

sync_clock.name: Sync clock
sync_clock.description: Sets the valve's clock to match Home Assistant's local time. The valve schedules regenerations against its own clock, so drift shifts when they run.

set_cycle_position_times.name: Set cycle position times
set_cycle_position_times.description: Configures the regeneration step durations (in minutes, or salt pounds for refill steps). Index 0 (service position) is preserved automatically.

positions.name: Position times
positions.description: List of integers (0–199, or 0–99 for salt pounds) starting at Position 1, e.g. [10, 60, 10, 8].
